name: magnesium
purpose: Hand sanitizer to help reduce bacteria that potentially can cause disease. for use when soap and water are not available.
uses: place enough product on hadns to cover all surfaces. rub hands together until dry. supervise children uner 6 years of age when using this product to avoid swallowing.
otcwarn: Stop use and ask a doctor if irritation or rash occurs. Keep out of reach of children.
